services.description: Service registry keyed by reverse-domain name.

propertyNames.title: Reverse Domain Name
propertyNames.description: Reverse-domain identifier used for collision-safe namespacing of capabilities, services, handlers, eligibility claims, and extension-contributed keys. Must contain at least two dot-separated segments (e.g., 'dev.ucp.shopping.checkout', 'com.example.loyalty_gold').

allOf.title: Product
allOf.description: A product in the catalog with variants and options.

id.description: Global ID (GID) uniquely identifying this product.

handle.description: URL-safe slug for SEO-friendly URLs (e.g., 'blue-runner-pro'). Use id for stable API references.

description.title: Description
description.description: Product description in one or more formats.

html.description: HTML-formatted content. Security: Platforms MUST sanitize before rendering—strip scripts, event handlers, and untrusted elements. Treat all rich text as untrusted input.

items.title: Category
items.description: A product category with optional taxonomy identifier.

categories.description: Product categories with optional taxonomy identifiers.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Amount in ISO 4217 minor units. Use 0 for free items.

amount.description: Amount in ISO 4217 minor units. Use 0 for free items.

list_price_range.title: Price Range
list_price_range.description: List price range before discounts (for strikethrough display).

amount.description: Amount in ISO 4217 minor units. Use 0 for free items.

media.description: Product media (images, videos, 3D models). First item is the featured media for listings.

items.title: Product Option
items.description: A product option such as size, color, or material.

items.title: Option Value
items.description: A selectable value for a product option.

id.description: Optional server-assigned identifier for this option value. When present in a selected_option, the server SHOULD use it for matching instead of label.

label.description: Display text for this option value (e.g., 'Small', 'Blue').

items.title: Variant
items.description: A purchasable variant of a product with specific option selections.

id.description: Global ID (GID) uniquely identifying this variant. Used as item.id in checkout.

sku.description: Business-assigned identifier for inventory and fulfillment.

type.description: Barcode standard. Well-known values: UPC, EAN, ISBN, GTIN, JAN.

barcodes.description: Industry-standard product identifiers for cross-reference and correlation.

description.title: Description
description.description: Variant description in one or more formats.

html.description: HTML-formatted content. Security: Platforms MUST sanitize before rendering—strip scripts, event handlers, and untrusted elements. Treat all rich text as untrusted input.

items.title: Category
items.description: A product category with optional taxonomy identifier.

categories.description: Variant categories with optional taxonomy identifiers.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Amount in ISO 4217 minor units. Use 0 for free items.

list_price.title: Price
list_price.description: List price before discounts (for strikethrough display).

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Amount in ISO 4217 minor units. Use 0 for free items.

unit_price.description: Price per standard unit of measurement. MAY be omitted when unit pricing does not apply.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Unit price in ISO 4217 minor units. Business MUST return precomputed unit price value: (variant.price / measure.value) * reference.value.

reference.description: Denominator for unit price display (e.g., per 100ml, per 1kg).

available.description: Whether this variant can be purchased. See status for fulfillment details.

status.description: Qualifies available with fulfillment state. Well-known values: `in_stock`, `backorder`, `preorder`, `out_of_stock`, `discontinued`.

items.title: Selected Option
items.description: A specific option selection on a variant (e.g., Size: Large).

id.description: Optional option value identifier from option_value.id. When present, the server SHOULD use it for matching; name and label remain required for display.

options.description: Option values that define this variant (e.g., Color: Blue, Size: Large).

media.description: Variant media (images, videos, 3D models). First item is the featured media for listings.

scale_min.description: Minimum value on the rating scale (e.g., 1 for 1-5 stars).

scale_max.description: Maximum value on the rating scale (e.g., 5 for 5-star).

count.description: Number of reviews contributing to the rating.

tags.description: Variant tags for categorization and search.

metadata.description: Business-defined custom data extending the standard variant model.

seller.description: Optional seller context for this variant.

type.description: Type of link. Well-known values: `privacy_policy`, `terms_of_service`, `refund_policy`, `shipping_policy`, `faq`. Consumers SHOULD handle unknown values gracefully by displaying them using the `title` field or omitting the link.

url.description: The actual URL pointing to the content to be displayed.

title.description: Optional display text for the link. When provided, use this instead of generating from type.

variants.description: Purchasable variants of this product. First item is the featured variant for listings.

count.description: Number of reviews contributing to the rating.

items.title: Input Correlation
items.description: Maps a request identifier to the variant it resolved to, with match semantics.

id.description: The identifier from the lookup request that resolved to this variant.

match.description: How the request identifier resolved to this variant. Well-known values: `exact` (input directly identifies this variant, e.g., variant ID, SKU), `featured` (server selected this variant as representative, e.g., product ID resolved to best match). Businesses MAY implement and provide additional resolution strategies.

inputs.description: Which request identifiers resolved to this variant, and how. Each entry maps a request ID to its match type.

products.description: Products matching the requested identifiers. May contain fewer items if some identifiers not found, or more if identifiers match multiple products.

items.title: Message
items.description: Container for error, warning, or info messages.

code.title: Error Code
code.description: Error code identifying the type of error. Standard errors are defined in specification (see examples), and have standardized semantics; freeform codes are permitted.

path.description: RFC 9535 JSONPath to the component the message refers to (e.g., $.items[1]).

severity.description: Reflects the resource state and recommended action. 'recoverable': platform can resolve by modifying inputs and retrying via API. 'requires_buyer_input': merchant requires information their API doesn't support collecting programmatically (checkout incomplete). 'requires_buyer_review': buyer must authorize before order placement due to policy, regulatory, or entitlement rules. 'unrecoverable': no valid resource exists to act on, retry with new resource or inputs. Errors with 'requires_*' severity contribute to 'status: requires_escalation'.

code.title: Warning Code
code.description: Warning code identifying the type of warning. Standard codes are defined in capability specs (see examples), and have standardized semantics; freeform codes are permitted.

content.description: Human-readable warning message that MUST be displayed.

presentation.description: Rendering contract for this warning. 'notice' (default): platform MUST display, MAY dismiss. 'disclosure': platform MUST display in proximity to the path-referenced component, MUST NOT hide or auto-dismiss. See specification for full contract.

image_url.description: URL to a required visual element (e.g., warning symbol, energy class label).

url.description: Reference URL for more information (e.g., regulatory site, registry entry, policy page).

path.description: RFC 9535 JSONPath to the component the message refers to.

code.title: Info Code
code.description: Info code identifying the type of informational message. Standard codes are defined in capability specs (see examples), and have standardized semantics; freeform codes are permitted.

messages.description: Errors, warnings, or informational messages about the requested items.
